name: money-craft
description: Evidence-first global investment research and wealth decision discipline.

interface.longDescription: Money Craft supports global company, industry, fund, portfolio, earnings, valuation, and thesis research with source binding, exact calculations, explicit provider gaps, an optional Fuyao A-share adapter, and an isolated optional yfinance adapter for Hong Kong and U.S. secondary market data.
defaultPrompt: Screen this global listed company for fundamental quality and red flags.
Research this global company or industry and bind every key fact to evidence.
Compare this fund or portfolio using official product documents and explicit risk constraints.
Review the latest earnings report and explain what changed.
Create or update a scenario valuation and investment thesis.
